fact: In February 2025 the health minister said Tunisia is developing a Tunisian AI software with InstaDeep for remote analysis of medical images, to diagnose conditions such as diabetic retinopathy and read scans, MRI and mammograms.
title: Forum Réalités sur la Santé numérique : 3500 nouvelles recrues et 95 % de dossiers médicaux numérisés
